_comment: PLACEHOLDER PROFILE. No value below was taken from the real ELEGOO 02.03.03.13 package; every TODO_ must be replaced with output of tools/inspect_base.py run on the user's own authenticated package. Even when complete, the build stays refused until a ported and tested patch set exists (ported_patch_set=false).
_comment_stock_package: exact file name of the official 02.03.03.13 .zip.sig, placed in builder/current/original_firmware/
_comment_embedded_filename_marker: version substring of the file name stored in the outer ELEG 0x04 header (inspect_base.py: outer.embedded_filename)
_comment_manifest: version and update_class fields of the decrypted official ota-package-list.json (inspect_base.py: manifest); copy them, never invent or raise them
_comment_ported_patch_set: true only after Z-offset, HTTP/network, camera, Dual Trust and reactor patches are ported to this base, emulation-tested and hardware-tested
